Cs101 gdb 

*My Selected Option: Option 1 - Unintentional / Careless Mistakes*

I agree with the IT Manager. In my opinion, careless mistakes are more dangerous and harder to manage than intentional attacks.

The main reason is that every employee can make a mistake. A malicious employee is only one person, but carelessness can happen with 100 employees every day. For example, an employee may use a weak password like "12345", click on a fake email link, or by mistake send a confidential file to the wrong person on WhatsApp or email.

Second, these mistakes are very hard to detect because there is no bad intention. No one tries to hide anything, so the company does not even know that data is leaked until it is too late.

A malicious attack can be stopped by strict access control and monitoring, but human error cannot be fully stopped by technology. It can only be reduced by regular training and awareness. That is why unintentional mistakes pose the greater threat to a company.
